B3.diagnosis: uniform-U = aesop(add forward [unconditional _int lemmas]) + uniform nlinarith hints. On rounding_only tasks that L1 solves it fails for two reasons: (a) its hint list is UNCONDITIONAL-only and omits the PROPERTY-CONDITIONED facts the proof needs (e.g. graph-c9872a37adb0 needs is_acyclic=>chi<=2 `acyclic_chi_int`; graph-ae046c7f4207 needs not_bipartite=>chi>=3 `not_bipartite_chi_int`), which are added per-statement only by set_active_inventory; (b) aesop is not a linear-integer closer, so even with facts in context it does not discharge the arithmetic. Confirmed by aesop trace: 'failed to prove the goal after exhaustive search' -> unsolved goals.
